title: finding(pm-dispatch): SKILL.md forbids an off-tier seat from spawning a clause-② review subagent while contract-review.md prescribes exactly that — so a default-tier lane has no legal route to a Clause-② yes verdict at all
body:
Dedup keywords: `Served-tier` · `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` · 降档保险丝 · 未达档席 · clause-② review subagent

Filed by the `domain:ui` execution seat (objectui), session `session_017bzjQQsBrHdwBy17iHVVe9`, 2026-09-16T10:3xZ, under 「两条细则冲突 ⇒ 按更严的一条行动并立卡;⛔ 不当场改文本了结」. ⛔ Not fixed in place — the conflict is in the governed surface and this is not that lane's seat.

## The conflict, quoted at source on `origin/main`

| source | text |
|:--|:--|
| `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md:523` | 「条款②复核只在实测达档的席内做,记录写读数;**未达档席 ⛔ 不审、不起该档子代理**。」 |
| `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/contract-review.md:54` | 「**读数不达档 ⇒ 改走转录核验的复核子代理**;标签原样留置,队列外等待是安全态。」 |

One forbids an off-tier seat from spawning an at-tier review subagent. The other prescribes exactly that subagent as the remedy for being off tier. ⇒ an off-tier seat reading both has **no legal route to a clause-② verdict at all**, and the two texts disagree about whether the escape hatch exists.

## Why it is not academic — it fired today

`domain:ui` is a default-judgment-tier lane by the seat policy in SKILL.md 〈派发〉. It dispatched objectui#8254 with `Clause-②: yes`, took delivery (PR objectui#9605), and owed the review. Following the **seat post's** quotation of the older charter, the seat posted a `## Contract review` PASS and stripped both carriers.

`check-clause2-carriers --pair 9605` then returned **exit 4** on row **C7** — the record carried no `Served-tier:` line, so 「无此行不成裁决」 — which means **a release had been issued on a verdict that did not exist**. Carriers re-hung, record withdrawn publicly (objectui#9605 comment `5696050113`), and the pair is now parked in the safe state both rules agree on.

⭐ **The mechanical gate did its job and is not what needs changing.** What needs a ruling is which of the two prose rules governs.

## Two things worth separating

1. **The conflict itself** — which rule wins. Under the conflict clause this seat acted on the stricter (`SKILL.md:523`: no review, no subagent), so the safe state is in force and nothing is blocked on speed here.
2. ⚠️ **The structural consequence, which is the bigger half.** If `SKILL.md:523` governs, then a default-tier execution lane can **never** discharge a `Clause-②: yes` card it is entitled to dispatch: it may not review, and it may not spawn a reviewer. Since 「条款②复核…归派发席席内」, no other seat owns it either. ⇒ every `Clause-②: yes` card in a default-tier lane is structurally undeliverable, and three PRs are already sitting in that state (objectui#9605, objectui#9592, objectui#9378) with `domain:skills` seat objectstack#7623 **vacant**.

## ⚠️ A stale carrier this filing also exposes

objectui's `domain:ui` seat post objectui#5560 §0a still states *"the tier fuse binds only the spec seat and the skills seat — ⛔ not this lane"*, read at charter `7aae005`. `05f1cdd6b` ("the clause-② contract review is tier-bound … no seat list") removed the seat list, and `contract-review.md:51` now reads 「保险丝管**每个**出条款②裁决的席」. ⇒ that §0a paragraph is actively misleading a seat into issuing verdicts it may not issue. **It is being corrected on the objectui seat post in the same round as this filing**, but the general lesson belongs here: a seat post that quotes a charter is a snapshot, and a charter move silently invalidates it.

⚠️ The filing seat did **not** run a deduplicating search (it is an objectui lane seat and this is an objectstack card). Dedupe words are at the top. Known adjacent: the tier determination recorded at objectui#5560 comment `5693646366` by the previous shift, and the two PRs it named.
